description: Trilinear and tetrahedral interpolation of generated .cube LUTs (luts/*.cube, license-free). Samples include grid nodes, cell centres, seeded random points, domain faces and out-of-domain points (clamped to the domain).
license: Generated numeric reference data; no third-party content. Same terms as the repository.

reference.use: OpenColorIO (float32) is the reference for in-domain and out-of-domain samples; a float64 port should match within 2e-6.

nodes.use: At grid nodes both interpolations return the table entry (as written to 10 decimals).

tetrahedralCheck.implementation: colour-science 0.4.6 table_interpolation_tetrahedral on the clamped samples

trilinearCheck.implementation: colour-science 0.4.6 table_interpolation_trilinear on the clamped samples

tetrahedralCheck.implementation: colour-science 0.4.6 table_interpolation_tetrahedral on the clamped samples

trilinearCheck.implementation: colour-science 0.4.6 table_interpolation_trilinear on the clamped samples

tetrahedralCheck.implementation: colour-science 0.4.6 table_interpolation_tetrahedral on the clamped samples

trilinearCheck.implementation: colour-science 0.4.6 table_interpolation_trilinear on the clamped samples

tetrahedralCheck.implementation: colour-science 0.4.6 table_interpolation_tetrahedral on the clamped samples

trilinearCheck.implementation: colour-science 0.4.6 table_interpolation_trilinear on the clamped samples

linearCheck.implementation: numpy.interp per channel on the clamped samples

note: The 3D LUT function is 0.85 r^1.3 + 0.15 g b, 0.75 g + 0.2 r^2 + 0.05 b, 0.65 sqrt(b) + 0.35 r g (negative inputs clamped to 0 when tabulated).
